title: Free shipping from 50 euros
notes: Synthetic change to the demo shop with seeded defects.

defects.summary: An order of exactly 50.00 euros pays shipping: the comparison is > instead of >=.
defects.caught_if: a condition checks shipping at exactly 50.00 euros (and just below) and expects it free at 50.00
defects.observed: shipping_cost for exactly 5000 cents returned 499; 0 expected

defects.summary: The threshold is checked on the subtotal before the coupon.
defects.trigger: a cart of 60 euros with a 25% coupon (45 euros paid)
defects.caught_if: a condition uses a coupon that takes the total below 50 euros and checks shipping is charged
defects.observed: 6000 cents with a 25% coupon: shipping 0; 499 expected
